turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Okay. I know who you are, Hale. Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me?
I haven't made any points yet, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Noise? I asked one question, Hale, and you haven't answered it. What facts do you have, and where are they?
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
I'm writing down "Your son cheated." My child never lies, and you've just said I'm teaching him to. Where is the document, Hale?
